one_liner: Generates professional B2B pricing PDFs for Puzzlup puzzle mats using real COGS data from Supabase with QUALICO branding

intelligence.notes: Expert needed for PDF generation with complex layouts and pricing calculations. Advanced sufficient for simple data lookups.

capabilities: Generate B2B pricing PDFs with QUALICO dark-theme branding
Calculate B2B unit prices from landed COGS (L0+L1+L2) with 2x margin markup
Fetch real product data (names, EANs, units/carton, dimensions) from Supabase
Apply Belgian general T&Cs (10 sections, Belgian law, Antwerp jurisdiction)
Create landscape PDF documents with ReportLab canvas
Calculate MOQ based on carton counts or pallet/CBM volume
Round prices upward to nearest EUR 0.50

example_queries: What are the puzzle mat SKUs?
Show me EANs for puzzle mats
How many units per carton for MAT BLACK GIFT 1000?
What is the B2B price for MAT BLACK LUX 1500?
What are the landed costs for Europe?
Generate a B2B pricing PDF for puzzle mats
Create a new pricing proposal with updated MOQ
Rebuild the PDF in landscape with QUALICO branding

connections.what_for: Read product info (Puzzlup_Product_Info), COGS data (COGS_Landed), branding guidelines (shared_knowledge), and push DNA data (Agents_Overview)
Push DNA dump to qualicoagents repo

key_rules: NEVER show COGS/unit costs to customers — only B2B prices
B2B Unit Price = total_landed_eur (L0+L1+L2) x 2, rounded UP to nearest EUR 0.50
Price per Master Carton = B2B Unit Price x units_per_master
All product data must come from Supabase — never make up product names or data
QUALICO branding: dark charcoal #1E1E1E edge-to-edge bg, blue #3B82F6 headers, white text, orange #FF6B35 accents

input_format.accepts: Natural language requests about B2B pricing for Puzzlup puzzle mats, MOQ changes, layout adjustments, PDF regeneration
example_queries: Generate a B2B pricing PDF for puzzle mats
Make the layout landscape and more spacious
Update prices with new COGS data
Add Belgian T&Cs to the proposal

output_format.returns: Professional PDF files with B2B pricing tables and Belgian T&Cs, styled with QUALICO branding

databases_tables.what_for: Landed cost data (L0+L1+L2) per product per region for pricing calculations
Product SKUs, EANs, units per master carton, master carton dimensions
QUALICO branding guidelines and styling rules

files_and_paths.what: Latest generated B2B pricing PDF for puzzle mats
